3180.a: Sawanoi Shuzo (Ozawa brewery), 2 Chome-770 Sawai, Ome, Tokyo 198-0172, Japan
3180.aj: 〒198-0172 東京都青梅市沢井２丁目７７０ 澤乃井 小澤酒造(株)

rv.t: The 大澤酒造 Ozawa Brewery in Sawai, Ome City, producer of Sawanoi Sake, has been brewing nihonshu since 1702 (元禄十五年). A wooden Kanban (sign board) is displayed at the entrance. It is about a two hour trip from Asakusa. There are Tokyo sake brewers closer to Tokyo but I am particularly fond of their 大辛口 Daikarakuchi (VERY dry sake). I visited today for a tour. Our group for the 11AM tour was barely ten participants. The…

This sake brewery is located in a beautiful mountain region of Japan. A terrific place for a memorable day trip out of Tokyo. The sake is excellent and there a shop that offers samples and bottles for purchase. There are a number of restaurants clustered in a wooded area by the river. They also offer a brewery tour but be sure to get tickets ahead of time. This is a popular place for hikers and nature lovers as well…

Really great experience. A beautiful region to check out, just a short train ride (1.5 hrs max) from Tokyo. The tour itself was not offered in English, however it was still very much worth being able to see the brewery, take home a sake cup and taste test the sake. A QR code is also provided and you can read up on the brewing process in English on their website as you go. Thank you!

3181.a: Japan, 〒158-0094 Tokyo, Setagaya City, Tamagawa, 1 Chome−14−1 Tsutaya Electrics, 二子玉川ライズ・ショッピングセンター テラスマーケット 1F・2F
3181.aj: 〒158-0094 東京都世田谷区玉川１丁目１４−１ 二子玉川 蔦屋家電 二子玉川ライズ・ショッピングセンター テラスマーケット 1F・2F
3181.ed: Visitors say this store offers a wide variety of stylish and innovative home appliances, books, and unique lifestyle goods, with many items available for hands-on testing. They also highlight the comfortable atmosphere, helpful staff, and convenient co-located cafes. Some reviews mention the atmosphere can be crowded.
3181.edj: このお店を訪れた人は、スタイリッシュで新しい家電、本、ユニークなライフスタイル用品が豊富に揃っていると評価しています。多くの商品が実際に試せることも特徴のようです。また、心地よい雰囲気や親切なスタッフ、併設されたカフェの便利さも高く評価されています。 クチコミの中には、店内が混雑しているという意見もあります。

rv.t: Attracted to the Book Street, full of books, books of different types, catering to different age groups. There is also a toy shop. There are also many items on display for Autumn Festival. Should visit the Herman Miller - a way of living, corner to get inspiration in setting up decoration in your home. Daily essentials for dressing up, beauty, kitchen, wardrobe, house decorations can be bought here.

It is a lifestyle shop with the best place made around books and spaces of various personalities that don't know how time passes, which is enough to have a pleasant experience. It is one of the most recommended places not only for local residents but also for those who like books that want something new and have a different experience in Tokyo.

Oh my God! The whole concept of shared lounge is amazing It is like my childhood memory going to a community library with good books and a relaxing place to chill and read. In this shared lounge there are beautiful and coZy corners for people to read and do their work. The snack bar is super amazing even though not everything is halal.

3182.ed: People say this bookstore offers a wide variety of books, including children's books, and features a unique design with connected stores like a popular bakery and Starbucks. They also highlight the comfortable and relaxing atmosphere, with many spots to sit and read. Visitors appreciate the free Wi-Fi and the overall clean and stylish environment.
3182.edj: この書店を利用した人は、児童書をはじめとする幅広いジャンルの本が揃っていると評価しています。人気のパン屋さんやスターバックスなど、複数の店舗が繋がったユニークなデザインも特徴のようです。また、座って本を読める場所が多く、快適でリラックスできる雰囲気も高く評価されています。無料Wi-Fiが利用でき、全体的に清潔でおしゃれな環境も、訪れた人に喜ばれています。

rv.t: very comfortable, but a little crowd and sitting time is limited (90mins)
Very clean location but gets busy and full quickly. The kids location upstairs is pretty busy and loud.
Food. Books. Coffee! Do I need to say more? :) Went there and there was summer bazaar nearby too, just great!

3184.aj: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内２丁目１−１ 静嘉堂文庫美術館 千代田区丸の内2-1-1 明治生命館1F

rv.t: The private Meiji museum is newly reopened in early 2023. As a history and Japanese drama lover, I definitely pay a visit as its national treasure: 曜變天目碗 yohen tenmoku tea bowl is on their exhibition list again. This tea bowl is one of three lasting completed bowls with unique inner design, which is made in Song dynasty, in the world. Its inner design contains the eye-liked bubble drawing which occurs randomly when…

There are more than 6,000 pieces of valuable antique collections for each themed exhibition. And this time; the most precious item is Inaba Tenmoku tea bowl. Only 3 tea bowls in existence and one is here.

Amazing museum display rare items to see. English audio guide. I was very surprised! Nice garden around (in summer a lot of mosquito, so use some cream). Bus stop near by. Easy to get from Futakotamagawa station.

3186.aj: 〒130-0015 東京都墨田区横網１丁目３−２８ 両国国技館
3186.ed: Indoor arena for sumo that will host boxing at the Olympics.
3186.edj: 相撲の取組が行われる屋内競技場。オリンピックのボクシング会場にもなった。

rv.t: I had the opportunity to visit Ryogoku Kokugikan during my recent trip to Japan, where I attended my company's annual Soukai event alongside colleagues and participants from around the world. Experiencing such a significant gathering at one of Japan's most prestigious sumo arenas made the occasion even more memorable. The venue itself is enormous, with seating for more than 11,000 guests, yet everything was…

Fantastic!! If you are in Tokyo and there's a tournament on it's a must visit. Great entertainment and brilliant atmosphere. We were so lucky to get tickets but we booked months in advance. Would definitely recommend.

If you visit Japan during an odd numbered month, you should seriously consider taking in a sumo tournament day. Weekends are packed so weekday visits are recommended. January, May and September feature tournaments here in Ryogoku but there are charity sumo events taking place all the time so check the website for the latest events. Sumo is so deep, ritualized, spiritual and ceremonial that I suggest you read up a…

3187.a: Shunkaen Bonsai Museum, 1 Chome-29-16 Niihori, Edogawa City, Tokyo 132-0001, Japan
3187.aj: 〒132-0001 東京都江戸川区新堀１丁目２９−１６ 春花園BONSAI美術館
3187.ed: Homey museum showcasing artful bonsai trees in sleek galleries & outdoor gardens with koi ponds.
3187.edj: 盆栽を展示する落ち着いた雰囲気の美術館。現代的なギャラリーや鯉池のある屋外庭園がある。

rv.t: Truly amazing gem hidden with beautiful work of nature in Tokyo; however, the fact of its location being secluded makes this place the best spot for peace and quiet from Tokyo itself. Highly recommended spot to visit and I also recommend formatting photos as portraits unless you want the entire background. For entry and real peaceful experience, I recommend coming here in the morning when this place opens as you get…

Absolutely a hidden gem. I know nothing about bonsai but find them fascinating. There were so many on display yet the space seemed so small. While I primarily walked around on my own, initially one of the elder employees used a translating device to tell me a bit about some of their most prized trees. There were other staff walking around tending to the trees. It’s a neat atmosphere.

It was an absolute HONOR to walk around and marvel at the mastery of this bonsai collection! Seriously a gift to be amongst these carefully and timelessly crafted living trees of all shapes sizes and specimens, many that have been alive for centuries even Millenium! A special Thank you to the bonsai master himself Kunio Kobayashi who took the time to have tea with me and show me around! Truly a day I won’t forget !

3188.ed: This large, waterfront park with many trees, aquatic plants & open space is a popular place to walk.
3188.edj: 広大な水郷公園。多くの木々や水生植物、広場がある人気の散歩スポット。

rv.t: A spacious, comfortable, and beautiful park. It’s perfect for picnics and spending time with family while enjoying nature. It’s not too crowded or maybe because the park is so large, it doesn’t feel crowded. Highly recommended to visit.

I often visit the park but I keep finding new interesting spots. The park is nicely maintained and beautiful during each season. There are many things available outside of a nice walk, such as dog runs, amusements for kids, bbq place, and more.. large parking and clean restrooms available at different spots across the park. Even at visits peak, you will always be able to find a calm spot for a nap or a picnic. If…

I was suggested to come out to this park for the seasonal leaf change, and even though it was a bit further out for me, it was still really pretty. I rated it a 4 out of 5 because the park itself is lovely, especially around sunset. If you’re standing on the right side of the lake, you can get some gorgeous views, which you’ll see in the photos I added. As for the leaves, there wasn’t much gold or red during my…

3189.a: Suntory Musashino Brewery, 3 Chome-1 Yazakicho, Fuchu, Tokyo 183-0025, Japan
3189.aj: 〒183-0025 東京都府中市矢崎町３丁目１ サントリー〈天然水のビール工場〉東京・武蔵野

rv.t: Good Factotrip! You need to reserve your spot online in advance. They send you emails all information needed including how to go to the factory. The staffs are so nice, welcome . They made the factory trip interesting and ending with beer tasting.

Had a great experience at Suntory Kyoto Brewery. The tour was an interesting journey through every detail of the brewing process, and you can really feel the craftsmanship behind it all. Beautiful beer — truly a work of art. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Japan and interested in quality brewing and Japanese attention to detail.
It’s nice experience to see beer production process. You can taste 3 types of beer. Need to book the ticket in advance, 3 days before visiting.

3190.a: ANA Blue Hangar Tour, Component Maintenance Building, 3 Chome-5-5 Hanedakuko, Ota City, Tokyo 144-0041, Japan
3190.aj: 〒144-0041 東京都大田区羽田空港３丁目５−５ コンポーネントメンテナンスビル ANA Blue Hangar Tour
catj: 航空機メンテナンス業

rv.t: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Absolute Highlight of Japan! If you are an aviation enthusiast or just looking for an incredible experience in Tokyo, the **ANA Blue Hangar Tour** is a must-see. Honestly, this was **100% better** than the paid Boeing Everett tour—and the best part? It’s completely **free**. 🛠️ The Experience Unlike other tours where you watch from a distant observation deck, this tour gets you **up close and personal** at…

Booking the hangar tour isn’t easy because of the time it goes on sale (9am JST) but trying is absolutely worth it. The tour itself is amazing as it is possible to walk around the aircraft, see absolutely anything that goes on, and have great views of the runway, on a good day even Mt. Fuji. We were incredibly lucky to have our tour conducted by one of ANA‘s most senior technicians, one of six Group Meisters…

It took us a few tries and couple months but we finally were able to make a reservation here. It was a great time they even had an English book for us to read while on the tour. This tour was about an hour long and they showed us the whole hangar while taking pictures of us along the way. This tour is worth the effort if you can figure out their website.

3191.a: Japan, 〒100-0004 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Ōtemachi, 2 Chome−2−1 （有）大宝堂藤巻印房 新大手町ビル １階
3191.aj: 〒100-0004 東京都千代田区大手町２丁目２−１ （有）大宝堂藤巻印房 新大手町ビル １階
3191.ed: Visitors say this workshop offers a unique and relaxing experience to carve a personalized hanko, a traditional Japanese stamp, and create a meaningful souvenir. They also highlight the knowledgeable and patient instructors who provide clear guidance, even with limited Japanese. Guests mention the engaging atmosphere and the opportunity to learn about Japanese culture and craftsmanship.
3191.edj: このワークショップを訪れた人は、自分だけのオリジナルな日本の伝統的な印鑑である「はんこ」を彫る体験が、ユニークでリラックスできる時間であり、思い出に残るお土産になると評価しています。日本語でのコミュニケーションに不安がある場合でも、知識が豊富で忍耐強い講師が明確な指導をしてくれるため、安心して参加できるという声が多くあります。また、日本の文化や職人技について学べる魅力的な雰囲気も好評です。

rv.t: Carving your own Hanko stamp on a trip to Tokyo, Japan is such a great way to have fun and you'll have an awesome souvenir to bring home. This is the THE place to do it! Good location and great service. Thank you so much! Arigato Gozaimasu!

It was super fun and enjoyable. It took less time than anticipated and it was nice to be able to do everything yourself from choosing the kanji to drawing it to carving and even the color of the ink. It was also nice that we were provided practice Hanko to get used to the carving before going on to the final!

Such a great workshop getting to carve your own hanko and learning a bit about the cultural gem that is Japanese stampmaking. Would recommend this to anyone interesting in learning about the craftsmanship! 5 stars!!!

3192.aj: 〒108-8611 東京都港区高輪４丁目１０−３０ 品川プリンスホテル内 マクセル アクアパーク 品川

rv.t: I visited on a whim to beat the heat and had a good experience overall. The presentation of the animals was decent and despite it being small, I was able to spend a lot of time here. I went with a friend but there were many couples and families present so it’s versatile. The dolphin shows were a highlight. They offer a great chance to see the dolphins up close and are offered frequently enough that you can take your…

Such a fun and surprisingly stylish aquarium right next to Shinagawa Station, super convenient to visit! It’s not your typical “look at fish in tanks” kind of place, they mix the aquarium experience with light shows, music, and digital projections, so it feels more like an art installation than a regular aquarium. The dolphin show here is a highlight, it’s performed with synchronized lighting, music, and even fog…

Visited Shinagawa Aqua Park and really enjoyed the experience. There are many different types of sea creatures to see, and the whole place is well designed and easy to explore. We watched the penguin show, seal show, and dolphin show. All of them were fun and entertaining, but the dolphin show was the highlight for me. The way they jump, fly, and swim together with music and lights looks amazing and very well…

Luckily, they still let us in, which we really appreciated. Since it was the last hour, the aquarium was almost empty — a rare and very enjoyable experience. We managed to walk through the entire aquarium in about 45 minutes, but under normal conditions, you would easily spend…

Visited Tokyo Sea Life Park and honestly had such a fun and relaxing day! The aquarium is spacious, family-friendly, and easy to explore even with kids. One of the biggest highlights was the giant maguro (bluefin tuna) tank — seeing the huge tuna swimming in circles was super impressive and definitely became the favorite spot for many children. There are also penguins, jellyfish, sharks, and many sea creatures from…

Went to the park to get pictures of birds native to Japan and saw there was an aquarium here. We made the decision to check it out and we were blown away by the variety of fish and birds in this small space. It was beautiful and amazing and well worth the price they were asking.

The language barrier made things a little challenging at times, but the experience was still enjoyable. We tried the fishing game and the mosquito-shooting game, had a light snack, and especially loved the dumplings—they were absolutely delicious. Just note that there is an entrance fee, and most activities and food are…

Not necessarily for American tourists - everything in Japanese only, expensive to do entry AND buy additional coins / passport for rides, food was overpriced and not very good / could get better at street vendors. It was a bit silly to experience it having no idea what Namja is, plus I love cats so the fun imagery and merch was cool but I wouldn’t waste your time if you don’t speak Japanese

While was roaming around sunshine mall, I saw the sign and got curious . When i saw kuroko basket and blue lock posters, it was no brainer for me and I got to find what's in Namjatown. The game event was for kuroko baskets 10th year anniversary + Cross over with gintama games. I saw displayed prizes and got crazy on 2 tapestry which I won !!. So basically every game inside is for 600 jpy so it's advisable to buy the…

3195.ed: Uniform displays, aircraft seats & a cockpit, plus tours of a working maintenance hangar.
3195.edj: 制服、飛行機の座席、コックピットの展示がある。作業中の整備格納庫も見学できる。

rv.t: If you like aviation, you have to visit here. Japan Airlines is doing their best to teach us their very long history and what tools each employee uses from pilots, cabin crew, maintenance crew and more. The first room that we gather around is ok but when they started talking about what this place is, the schedule, and other details, they had this particular vibe using a powerpoint that felt like I’m at a 会社説明会 or on…

The JAL Sky Museum at Tokyo Haneda Airport is an absolute dream for anyone interested in aviation. It offers an incredible, immersive behind-the-scenes look at Japan Airlines. The Hangar Tour: The ultimate highlight. Walking onto the actual maintenance floor puts you just meters away from massive Boeing 767s and 787s. Interactive Exhibits: You can explore the history of JAL uniforms, sit in a mock cockpit, and learn…

RESERVATION STRONGLY RECOMMENDED! I bought my tickets a few weeks before going and found that it was good idea as the tour sold out early. For 1000¥ this might be THE BEST aviation related thing you can do near Haneda Airport (short of the free observation decks obviously). The tour was entirely in Japanese, so while it was very enjoyable, it was difficult to understand the information and explanations of the Hangar…

3196.a: Asakusa Taiyaki Guraku, 2 Chome-3-2 Nishiasakusa, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0035, Japan
3196.aj: 〒111-0035 東京都台東区西浅草２丁目３−２ 浅草たい焼き工房 求楽（ぐらく）asakusa taiyaki guraku
3196.ed: Visitors say this place offers a unique and enjoyable taiyaki-making experience with a wide variety of delicious fillings, including sweet and savory options. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the friendly, helpful staff who provide clear instructions and take photos.
3196.edj: この場所を訪れた人は、ユニークで楽しい、たい焼き作り体験ができると評価しています。甘いものからおかず系まで、様々な種類の美味しい具材が豊富に揃っている点が好評です。また、手頃な価格設定や、丁寧な説明と写真撮影をしてくれる親切なスタッフも高く評価されています。

rv.t: Tucked away and such a nice find—this spot was the perfect reprieve from the hot sun while exploring the area. We stopped in and really enjoyed the experience at Asakusa Taiyaki Kobo Guraku. The taiyaki was delicious—we tried the original red bean, and my daughter got the cream cheese, which she loved. For drinks, I had the cold rooibos tea (super refreshing), and my daughter enjoyed the fresh strawberry drink. We…

The taiyaki at Taiyaki Gurako was absolutely delicious. We tried the traditional seasonal flavor and the red bean one, and both were incredibly fresh and full of that classic taste you hope to find in Asakusa. It’s the kind of simple, perfect snack that makes wandering the neighborhood even better. What really made the visit special were the owners. They were so friendly, welcoming, and genuinely happy to chat…

Had an excellent experience here! The taiyaki was absolutely delicious and served piping hot. You can really tell that it's freshly made right on the spot. The crispy outside and warm filling were perfect. Highly recommend stopping by for a fresh treat!

3196.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

3197.a: Japan, 〒101-0044 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Kajicho, 2 Chome−2−9 第2登栄ビル 3階 日本文化体験 庵an東京 / AN TOKYO Japanese Culture Experience
3197.aj: 〒101-0044 東京都千代田区鍛冶町２丁目２−９ 第2登栄ビル 3階 日本文化体験 庵an東京 / AN TOKYO Japanese Culture Experience
3197.ed: People say this workshop offers engaging wagashi (Japanese sweets) making classes and simplified tea ceremony experiences. They also highlight the knowledgeable staff who provide clear instructions in both Japanese and English. Visitors appreciate the reasonable prices, the option to take home their creations, and the rotating seasonal themes for the sweets.
3197.edj: このワークショップを利用した人は、魅力的な和菓子作り体験と、気軽に楽しめる茶道体験を高く評価しています。知識豊富なスタッフが日本語と英語の両方で分かりやすく説明してくれる点も好評です。手頃な価格で、作った和菓子を持ち帰れること、そして季節ごとに変わる和菓子のテーマも、訪れる人々に喜ばれています。

rv.t: It's a cute place where you can have a traditional tea ceremony and a course on how to make the Japanese wagashi (sweets). We really enjoyed the ceremony where we learned about the difference between matcha (てんちゃ) and tea (せんちゃ), which was very educative for every foreigner in my opinion. We also had a really nice time making the sweets and then tasting them 😁 ありがとうございました!

We booked the sweets and tea experience. I highly recommend booking all three wagashi, ohigashi, and tea making, so you can drink the tea and eat the sweets at the same time. Our teacher was very personable and tried her best with English. Thank you again for the wonderful experience!

Booked via klook. Started on time and kids finished the sweets on time. It was good that the design was simple enough for kids to make. There were many Japanese people at the session and very well priced. 2800 yen per person. 90 minute session. Step explained in more detail in Japanese but was sufficient in English to get the job done.

rv.t: Very local coffee joint. Cash/suica only. Large range of coffee, can buy beans. Limited breakfast menu of toast, cinnamon toast, sandwiches and a hotdog! (side of a boiled egg/salad). Very reasonable prices and the staff are so lovely. It's a bit smokey because smokers go upstairs and it creeps down but we were fine. Atmospheric and authentic without being contrived.

Decent coffee, friendly staff and sizeable space. However the cigarette smell is obvious in the non smoking area. Large latte came with a cinnamon stick. 1. Stirring You use it like a stirrer to mix the drink. It releases a subtle cinnamon aroma into your cocoa/latte. 2. Light flavoring As it warms in the drink, it slowly adds a mild cinnamon taste without overpowering it. 3. Aromatics Some kissatens give cinnamon…

Close by the station on a lovely quiet street, a great range of coffee with some English descriptions. Inside it’s a cute vintage kissen that’s been trading since the 1950’s. Staff are attentive and friendly. Be aware they still have a smoking section, and even the non smoking section smells like smoke.

rv.t: The entrance, with its modern brick facade and industrial brass door sets the tone for a highly curated, sophisticated cafe experience. The ambient lighting and spacious layout create a comfortable atmosphere perfect for a relaxing coffee break. I paired a hot hand drip coffee with their homemade tiramisu, and both were outstanding. The presentation is pure artistry. The coffee is served in a beautiful, textured…

Stylish cafe located on the 2nd floor of the hotel. Most of the customers are also staying at the hotel, but the cafe is open to the public. It's a bit overpriced (700-1,000 yen for a drink) with very limited food options (a salad, club sandwich, bolognese pasta, and curry pasta). The latte was exceptionally made. They have plugs at most of the seats and free/fast WiFi so it is a comfortable place to get some work…

It’s a beautiful little cafe, very quiet. I got the savory french toast. It was okay, but the size was small. I would say the club sandwhich is the best item to order! it’s big (two people could share) and absolutely delicious. The espresso butter crepe was okay. The iced oatmilk chai was incredible. Definitely give it a try if you like chai

rv.t: A large, very well presented, detailed and informative museum of Japanese history and culture from prehistoric times to modern Japan. Beautiful permanent exhibits in 6 large halls (hall 5 closed for renovation during our visit). Often Special Exhibitions too. Most narrative in Japanese but titles in English too which is enough. There is a lot so you could spend hours if you want to. I was there for 1,5hours which…
Really informative, could more English translations. 900 yen for each adult children fee, students 500. Staff very helpful.
What an incredible museum. Extensively covers the rich history of Japan with some truly amazing displays. The dioramas are a sight to behold. Cheap entry price too. Check it out!!

3201.a: Mitsui Fudosan Ice Park Funabashi, 2 Chome-1-60 Hamacho, Funabashi, Chiba 273-0012, Japan
3201.aj: 〒273-0012 千葉県船橋市浜町２丁目１−６０ 三井不動産アイスパーク船橋

They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, and the availability of free lockers for small items. Other reviews mention the parking can be limited and crowded.
3201.edj: このアイススケートリンクを利用した人からは、氷の状態が良く滑りやすいというクチコミが多くあります。ヘルメットやプロテクターは、子どもから大人まで幅広いサイズが無料で借りられるようです。また、スタッフは親切で対応が良いという声や、小物を入れられる無料ロッカーがあることも好評です。 一方で、駐車場が限られており、混雑することがあるという意見もあります。

rv.t: I love that it’s an indoor ice skating rink—you can visit any time of year, no matter the weather, with family and friends. The place is clean and well-organized, and I appreciate that there are two rinks available. The B rink is great for beginners. There are also plenty of seats to relax in and a wide variety of drinks from the vending machines. Our family always enjoys coming here!

While I liked that the rink is rather new and has enough space because there are 2 separate rinks, I thought the rental skates were uncomfortable. I usually don’t have any issues with rental skates as I have average-sized feet, but these skates just had a bad fit around my feet. They were hard and there was too much space in some areas. I could also not tie them nice and tight. In conclusion, I do recommend this…
Nice new rink. And for 500 yen you can try an Ice Board!

rv.t: If you're interested in space exploration, this is a must! Wonderful staff! Fun interactions, educational, with around lovely cafe featuring space themed menu. Great for kids and adults alike! Make sure to do the VR experience, where you're launched to the moon! It was a blast! Pun intended! 10/10!!

I think whether pregnant woman can enjoy the VR should absolutely and solely depends on the woman herself. If she is in good condition and/or often participate in this kind of activities, she can make the call of doing it on all her responsibility. The venue itself can advise but is VR a hard NO for pregnant woman? I may hold different opinion. Btw, I was there with my husband and my good friend. If one parent can…

They welcomed us in and gave us a lesson on the origins of shibori dyeing and provided lots of guidance in dying our own craft. They were so sweet and helpful, more than worth the money for such an interactive and memorable…

Really enjoyed doing they workshop at Wanariya - the staff were very patient, friendly and gave clear instructions. The patterns they create in the shop are incredible but in a workshop it's limited to more simple designs which are manageable to novices. The process is very easy to follow and the results are always unique; the colour that they achieve is amazing. Would recommend to pretty much anyone; age isn't…

rv.t: A stunning must-visit destination in Ibaraki Prefecture! I visited in April and was blown away by the endless fields of blue Nemophila and the vibrant tulip gardens with hundreds of colors. The park is massive and offers beautiful sea views, along with plenty of food and drink options. There is even an amusement park area with fun rides and games, making it perfect for a full-day trip. Highly recommended for nature…

A huge park. Took a public bus from Katsuta train station. Clear signs so easy to know which berth to wait for the bus. Suica wasn’t accepted so I tapped my credit card to pay for the bus. Park itself is very big and I went in June, not the season for flowers. The flower beds were being cultivated for future blooms. Rented a bike and cycled around the park. Enjoyed the park. Very pleasant and weather was cool and…

We enjoyed our time at the park and were fortunate enough to visit during full blooming of tulips, which are one of my favourite flowers. 3207.edj: このお店では、多種多様な高品質な材料から自分だけの出汁パックを作ることができ、ユニークで楽しい体験ができると評判です。また、知識が豊富で丁寧なスタッフが、英語で分かりやすく説明し、役立つアドバイスをしてくれる点も高く評価されています。利用した人は、様々な材料の香りを試したり、試飲したりできる機会を楽しみ、思い出に残る自分だけのお土産が作れると喜んでいます。

rv.t: We had an amazing experience at Dashi Okume in Azabudai Hill Plaza! This shop specialises in dashi soup packs, and the best part is that you can taste various dashis before you buy the pre packed soup packs. It is a great way to find your favourites! They also offer a unique option to mix and match your favourite ingredients. The staff will then grind and pack them into individual small soup bags for you, making it…

Managed to get the session for custom dashi making at around 3pm. Store had few customers so we were a bit lucky. Service was really good, even though we don't speak Japanese, the staff was patient with us and walked us through entire process about how to compose the stock, and even giving some recommendations. Overall price point is not too bad, given that you're making something custom for yourself from scratch…

The staff here are incredibly sincere and enthusiastic! Mayuko-san gave us a detailed introduction to every ingredient for the soup packets, which was so helpful. rv.t: We had a great time at Yomiuriland! It has a very local atmosphere, which made the experience feel more authentic and relaxed compared to other major theme parks. One of the best things was that we didn’t have to wait in long lines, so we could enjoy many rides throughout the day. The rides were exciting and thrilling, with plenty of adrenaline-pumping attractions. If you’re looking for a fun amusement park with…

A visit to Yomiuri Land is a charming and surprisingly relaxed amusement park experience just outside Tokyo. The park is relatively small and sweet, making it a great half-day or full-day trip, especially considering it is only about 60 minutes by train from central Tokyo. The easiest way to get there is by taking the Keio Line to Keiō-yomiuri-land Station. From the station, one of the highlights already begins: a…

The park is quite large, with various attractions, a varied and delicious food selection, and excellent service. There's ample parking and easy access. I recommend buying tickets in advance and arriving half an hour before the park opens. During the winter season, there's a light show that makes it magical at night.

There wasn't many people when I went. The staff were really…

We had a great tour here. The wonderful lady who guided my family was very friendly, enthusiastic and thoughtful. She gave us English instructions in a way that was easy to understand. We appreciate you for helping us so much. Wishing you always have lots of joy, health and enjoy every day. Really interesting to place to go with kids! parking and entry is free of charge. The space airplane simulator is the best. Kids really enjoyed.

rv.t: One of my dream museums ❤️ Please buy your ticket a month in advance! They don't sell ticket in the museum. The museum was beyond my imagination. The facade was very distinctive and beautiful. The moment I descended the stairs, the museum sucked you into the whimsical, beautiful world of Studio Ghibli and its creations. Being a fan since very young, I was so happy I cried in joy quietly. The interior was oh so…

A beautiful museum that makes you feel like you're stepping into someone's home. No photos are allowed inside but you'll find exhibitions of animators and painters desks, camera riggs and a wide variety of rotoscopes. It's a fascinating space that encourages exploration. The giant cat bus play area was a highlight for my daughter. The cinema shows exclusive short films that rotate on a monthly basis, we had a story…

If yoi a fan of the Ghibli studio films then you will enjoy this museum! We booked a private tour who brought the tickets for us. We then met up in a group and proceeded inside. Obviously you can't take photos inside but me and my wife had a blast. If only the place is a little short it was still great fun. There is also a really great park near with lots of toliets. The museum also has good toliet facilities

rv.t: In Orinami workshop in Asakusa, is meant for creating your own weaved omamori. Japanese amulet-omamori is meant to wish you well, protect you, your house or your family. English speaking staff kindly explained and demonstrated each step and also I was impressed to see the seeds of cotton for the first time in my life. First I had to select 5 colors of yarn that will make my pattern of the omamori. Then put them on…

We had such a fantastic experience at this workshop! The hand-making activity was fun, well organised, and really enjoyable from start to finish. The staff were welcoming, patient, and explained everything clearly, making it easy to create something special to take home. It was a memorable experience and one of the highlights of our trip. I would 100% recommend it to anyone looking for a unique and enjoyable…

I didn’t expect a one-hour workshop to leave such a lasting impression but this one genuinely did. You get to hand-weave your own omamori — a traditional Japanese protective charm — right in Asakusa, just a 2-minute walk from Senso-ji Temple. You choose 5 yarns from 24 colors, all blessed at Tenjuku Shrine, then weave them row by row on a little loom until it takes shape. Then you add a wish patch, a double-knot…

Located in Ueno Park, the museum complex is very huge and filled with an incredible range of collections. I really enjoyed exploring the exhibits, which cover Japanese history from ancient times to the modern era. One of the highlights for me was the collection of kimono—some of them were truly…

Located in Ueno park the walk up to the museum is beautiful. Walking around the grounds of the museum itself is very pleasant as they are well kept. The Honkan building which is in the centre of the courtyard and looks very traditional. This was my favourite part of the visit. Seeing the extensive collection of Japanese heritage, artwork and history was a highlight of our trip. The katanas and pottery were incredible

This museum is absolutely massive and a must-visit if you want to learn about Japanese history and culture! The collection here is unbelievable. They have everything from ancient samurai armor and swords to beautiful pottery, kimono, and woodblock prints. The main building (Honkan) is beautiful both inside and out, and there is a really peaceful pond and garden area where you can walk around. Everything is very well…

It takes place once a year, before the end of the academic year in March. If you have the chance to spend a few hours there, I would also recommend the restaurant. The National Art Center is worth visiting even if you’re not planning to see an exhibition. The building itself is a masterpiece of modern architecture, with its stunning curved glass façade, open spaces, and beautiful natural light creating an impressive atmosphere from the moment you enter. One of the best things about this museum is that admission to the building is free, making it a great place to explore…

The National Art Centre, Tokyo is huge with a large selection of galleries. There was a special exhibit on Young British Artists and a wide collection of Calligraphy when I visited. The scale of the museum is impressive with collections displayed from all over the world. I was impressed by the gift shops they have on site. There are also lockers available to store bags

It was May, so the cherry blossom season was over, but I was able to enjoy a refreshing walk surrounded by lush greenery. There's a shrine in…

I visited Inokashira Park and had a very relaxing experience. The park is very spacious and full of beautiful greenery, which makes it a perfect place to escape the busy city life of Tokyo. One of the most attractive parts of the park is the large pond in the center where people can enjoy swan boats and small rowing boats. Watching the boats on the water creates a very peaceful and pleasant atmosphere. The walking…

Very beautiful and well-laid-out urban park with everything you’d expect for a relaxing escape. Public toilets are easy to find, there’s a small temple in the middle, and a lovely lake with swan pedal boats that adds to the charm. It’s within walking distance from the station and conveniently connected to the zoo and the Ghibli Museum. The atmosphere is very tranquil and feels like a true pause from the hustle and…

3216.a: Polar Science Museum, １０-３ Midoricho, Tachikawa, Tokyo 190-8518, Japan
3216.aj: 〒190-8518 東京都立川市緑町１０−３ 国立極地研究所 南極・北極科学館
3216.ed: Industrial-style space showcasing taxidermy & meteorites, plus expedition vehicles & tools.
3216.edj: インダストリアル調の科学館。剥製、隕石、南極調査隊の車や道具を展示する。

rv.t: A free museum with really cool stuff (pun intended). It’s not a big museum, but it’s very well made, and the staff is previous expedition members and you can really tell they burn for the arctics with a passion. A big enjoyment bonus if you are a fan of the show A Place Further Than the Universe, which visits this museum in an episode.

Interesting exhibits! Some had English translations but others did not, so I had to use google translate. Also, the shop was not open when I went (Wednesday) so slightly disappointed. The Aurora sphere was cool.

Free museum. Relatively close to Tachikawa Station - maybe a 15 minute walk. Enjoyed touching ice from the Antarctic. Interactive displays with microscopes to see minerals and other materials up close. Small but fun and worth a quick visit if you're in the area.

3216.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

3217.a: Japan, 〒626-0003 Kyoto, Miyazu, Ryoshi, 1775-25 天橋立市場食堂街(２F）
3217.aj: 〒626-0003 京都府宮津市漁師１７７５−２５ 天橋立市場食堂街(２F）
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店

rv.t: Good value for the price but not exceeding expectation. It's like you are at grand parents, at home atmosphere but not feeling like you are in the restaurant. If some of you may prefer a place clean/neat/looking better, then better go to Totomart next door. Fresh and good seafood, but the rice overcooked a bit, somehow cold tea served, one was watery. Overall it's good to try once but not to repeat.

We stumbled across this place by accident and it was delightful! The food is amazing. We had the sashimi set, the chef's choice set meal, and the special fresh seafood rice bowl. The fish was incredibly fresh and presented in thick slices, along with some cooked whole small fish, rice, a bowl of miso and some fresh salad. The set meals were 1500Y-1800Y. The space is very basic, but the two ladies who run it were…
Lots of food, nice owner, affordable price

3217.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

3218.a: Japan, 〒626-0001 Kyoto, Miyazu, Monju, 471-1 文珠荘 勘七茶屋
3218.aj: 〒626-0001 京都府宮津市文珠４７１−１ 文珠荘 勘七茶屋
3218.ed: Diners like this cafe's soft and chewy mochi, especially the Chie no Mochi with its balanced sweet red bean paste, and the Kinako Mochi with its subtly sweet kinako powder. They also appreciate the self-service hot and cold tea, and the clean interior. Other reviews mention there can be an unexpected one-order-per-person policy.
3218.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、やわらかくてもちもちとしたお餅が高く評価されています。特に、甘さのバランスが良いこしあんの「知恵の餅」や、ほんのり甘いきな粉がまぶされた「きな粉餅」が人気のようです。また、セルフサービスで温かいお茶と冷たいお茶が用意されている点や、清潔な店内も好評です。 一方で、一人につき一品注文する必要があるという、予期せぬルールがあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Very nice ice cream with red bean paste. Mochi is also nice and chewy. Highly recommended.

A very best Japanese sweet store around the area. The restroom also very clean. Price is good. Tea is great. And mochi was one of the best. My friend had red bean/mochi also very light and delicious, not too sweet.

We were not hungry then so we did not eat the famous mochi but we bought pine needle juice. It reminded us of a french drink, menthe l'eau (peppermint water). The drink was really nice especially during the rainy season or hot summer. It really hit the spot right after walking the Kaisen Bashi. An employee told us that they boil the pine needle to make the juice. We have never tasted the pine needle or its drink but…

3219.aj: 〒629-2242 京都府宮津市大垣４８ よし乃や
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
3219.ed: Diners like this restaurant's fresh and delicious seasonal squid bowls, which are often described as sweet and firm, and also enjoy the variety of seafood offerings. They also highlight the convenient location near the lift and cable car station, and the kind staff. Other reviews mention the service can be slow.
3219.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーは、新鮮で美味しい旬のイカ丼を高く評価しています。イカは甘くて歯ごたえがあり、絶品という声が多くあります。また、様々な種類の海鮮料理も楽しめるようです。リフトやケーブルカー乗り場に近い便利な立地や、親切なスタッフも好評です。 一方で、料理の提供が遅いというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: This day tour lunch venue is conveniently located near the cable car station, often accommodating numerous tour groups simultaneously. The meal portions are substantial, suitable for an average adult. The crab is notably fresh, and the chicken pot is flavorsome and enjoyable.

After our chairlift experience at Fuchu stn, we had lunch at Yoshinoya eatery. A nice family type restaurant on the 2nd floor. They serve all sorts of Japanese food like udon, soba, curry rice, ramen, sukiyaki, etc. We ordered the curry rice, meat suki, eel rice. Taste was okay..., service was nice. Waiting time can be abt an hour. Price was not cheap at this touristy location. Ambience was alright, and view was…
Good seafood, good restaurant. Will go again for sure!

3219.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

3220.aj: 〒629-2233 京都府宮津市溝尻２４７ 天橋立 旬の味 雪舟庵

rv.t: The best view through the glass. The lunch was also very tasty
If you are travelled who can’t speak Japanese , don’t come to this restaurant. The owner will not welcome foreigners
The best restaurant in the town… We really love this place! we were really happy! Thank you 🙏

3220.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

3221.aj: 〒629-2244 京都府宮津市江尻７１ 本格手打ちうどん すぎのや
3221.ed: Diners like this restaurant's handmade udon, noting its firm, chewy texture and delicious broth, along with crispy tempura, especially the black chikuwa. They also highlight the reasonable prices for the quality and the friendly, welcoming staff. Guests mention the availability of English menus and helpful amenities for children.
3221.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、手打ちうどんを高く評価しています。しっかりとしたコシと弾力のある麺、そしておいしい出汁が特徴のようです。特に、サクサクとした食感の天ぷら、中でも黒ちくわの天ぷらが絶品という声が多くあります。質の高い料理にもかかわらず、価格が手頃である点も評判のようです。また、スタッフは親切で温かく、親しみやすいというクチコミが多くあります。英語のメニューが用意されていることや、子ども用の食器やうどんをカットする道具を貸してくれるなど、子連れに優しいサービスも好評です。

rv.t: has to be one of the top delicious mochi mochi udon ever. completely devoured the food. i want to come again if possible to try their cold udon. super good, all udon and everything handmade, very friendly and helpful staff. english menu available :) this bowl of tempura and hot udon was 1200 yen. very worth it.
The food is freshly made. The udon is one of the best I have had so far. I highly recommend this.

Love the simplicity and yet tasty udon. I’m a first time tourist and was seeking for food- love the concept of a soveneir shop linked with the small humble restaurant. Was warmly welcome by an elderly staff. He was friendly and smiling and told me wrote my name on a chart as I was on waitlist for a table. Was given a counter table and I ordered the hot udon with tempura set. The broth was clear and delicious. You…

3221.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30（土）

3222.a: Japan, 〒626-0071 Kyoto, Miyazu, Yura, Yuragawa Railway Bridge, 川橋梁 舞鶴市
3222.aj: 〒626-0071 京都府宮津市由良由良川橋梁（由良川鉄橋） 川橋梁 舞鶴市
3222.ed: Visitors say this tourist destination offers stunning, expansive views of the Yuragawa Railway Bridge, where trains appear to run directly over the water. They also highlight the picturesque scenery, which many find reminiscent of a fantasy setting. Others also say it's a great spot for photography, especially when a train passes, and recommend checking the train schedule beforehand.
3222.edj: この観光地を訪れた人からは、由良川橋梁の壮大で広々とした景色が素晴らしいというクチコミが多くあります。列車がまるで水上を走っているように見える点が特に印象的で、幻想的な風景だと感じる人もいるようです。また、列車が通過する際の写真撮影に最適な場所だという声もあり、事前に時刻表を確認することをおすすめする意見も寄せられています。

rv.t: About a five-minute walk from the nearby Tango-Yura Station. There is a parking lot at the station.
Gotta prepare some times and check the train schedule in advance. The train frequency is not many, estimate every 30mins for next train.
Link from tangyura station

3223.a: Hashidate Chaya, 天橋立公園 内 643-1 Monju, Miyazu, Kyoto 626-0001, Japan
3223.aj: 〒626-0001 京都府宮津市文珠６４３−１ 内 天橋立公園 はしだて茶屋
3223.ed: Diners like this teahouse's clam rice bowls, udon, and soba, as well as the sweet dango and freshly grilled black chikuwa. They also highlight the quiet, relaxing atmosphere and the staff's kind service. Other reviews mention the clam dishes can be bland.
3223.edj: この茶屋を訪れたユーザーは、あさり丼、うどん、そばなどの食事メニューや、甘い団子、焼きたての黒ちくわを高く評価しています。静かで落ち着いた雰囲気や、スタッフの親切なサービスも好評のようです。 一方で、あさり料理の味が薄いというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Must try clam udon (Asari udon)! Very simple but delicate. I also love the dango :)

We stopped by a restaurant, Hashidate Chaya, and deduced that clams might be the local specialty, so we all opted for clam udon. We counted them; each of us had 11 clams, the soup was super fresh and umami but I thought the udon wasn't as good as those I had before in Kyoto and Osaka.

Outside dinning experience with grill. They provided the charcoal grill for you and you just go pick/order your food at the counter +pay there. The food is fresh most of the things are good and tasty except soba noodle. The oysters was great with grill. If you don’t know how to open it, the restaurant could do it for you. The price is not bad but not cheap, still affordable.

3223.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:30

3224.a: Funaya Shokudo, 491 Hirata, Ine, Yoza District, Kyoto 626-0423, Japan
3224.aj: 〒626-0423 京都府与謝郡伊根町平田４９１ 舟屋食堂
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
3224.ed: Diners appreciate this restaurant's efficient service, reasonable prices, and scenic views, and enjoy the good sashimi and buri. Other reviews mention the service can be impolite and the food can lack freshness.
3224.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、効率的なサービス、手頃な価格、そして美しい景色を高く評価しており、新鮮な刺身やブリを楽しんでいるようです。 一方で、サービスが丁寧でないというクチコミや、料理の鮮度が低いという意見もあります。

rv.t: Saw some bad review on Gmaps. But its the closest to the bus station. And it was raining. So i give it a go. Overall service is efficient and polite. Some also said the food is not freshly made since its serve quickly. I can understand maybe they have a big number of customers on lunch rush. I went there around 11 to avoid it. And the service is just nice. The food is japan standart good. The view is definitely…
Not sure why there are that many negative reviews. From my experience: nice service, fresh ingredient and gorgeous view, highly recommend! Only draw back: not accepting cards..

Probably the worst food experience I’ve had in Japan. Ordered the unagi set for 3000 yen. It came dry and burnt. It was likely microwaved. Also tried the sake but it felt watered down. Very disappointing. The window view is probably the only saving grace of this place

3225.a: Wadatsumi Sushi Restaurant, ５９３番地１ Hirata, Ine, Yoza District, Kyoto 626-0424, Japan
3225.aj: 〒626-0424 京都府与謝郡伊根町平田５９３番地１ 鮨割烹 海宮
3225.ed: Diners like this restaurant's fresh and delicious fish dishes, including sashimi, grilled fish, and braised fish, with many highlighting the generous portion sizes. They also mention the excellent service and the beautiful views of Ine Bay.
3225.edj: このお店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、新鮮で美味しい魚料理が高く評価されています。刺身、焼き魚、煮魚などがあり、どれもボリューム満点だという声が多くあります。また、サービスの良さや伊根湾の美しい景色も好評のようです。

rv.t: The most scenic setting to eat in Ine. See pics. A tremendous sushi and sashimi platter including sea snails for approx $28 US. Also the first time I ever ate raw shrimp sashimi; I almost hesitated but in the end finished everything. And the meal also included a tasty fried fish. The only reason I gave it a 4 in service is due to the “set” menu that I am not a fan of. Personal preference.

A high-end sushi shop at the heart of Ine, Kyoto. We didn’t have a reservation but we still enetered without flaws but it was already 2PM so had to eat fast. The lunch menu I had was “Wadatsumi Sushi Gozen” which had sushi, steamed fish, sashimi, snail, soup and chawan mushi. I got in a good spot to sit so I had a good view of the Ine sealine and even better in front the chef preparing our sushi. The sushi and…

We order ¥8000 course for adults, which can be share with kids. Our family has 6 adults and 6 kids under 8. The experience would have been awesome if the waitress was more friendly. But it was ok. Sashimi with local fish types was fresh.

3225.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

3226.a: Conveyor Belt Sushi "Kinpa Ginpa", 1988-1 Shinhama, Miyazu, Kyoto 626-0016, Japan
3226.aj: 〒626-0016 京都府宮津市新浜１９８８−１ 回転寿司 金ぱ銀ぱ
3226.ed: Diners like this sushi restaurant's fresh, large sushi toppings, especially the tuna and local fish, and appreciate the wide variety of offerings. They also highlight the clean interior, friendly staff, and reasonable prices, noting it offers good value. Some reviews mention the sushi can be overpriced.
3226.edj: この寿司レストランを利用した人は、新鮮で大きな寿司ネタ、特にマグロや地元の魚を高く評価しており、提供される種類の豊富さに満足しているようです。また、清潔な店内、親しみやすいスタッフ、そして手頃な価格も評価されており、良い価値を提供しているという意見が多くあります。 一方で、寿司が割高だと感じるというクチコミも一部見受けられます。

rv.t: Nice modern and clean place with a large range of different sushi. The actual sushi was not bad, but the tempura was unfortunately & we couldn’t eat it. Cost wise it seemed pretty cheap so overall if you want a conveyor belt sushi in miyazu then this should satisfy you.

This may look like your usual conveyor belt sushi spot, but the quality and freshness of the seafood really exceeded my expectations—especially at this price point. The sushi was so good, I didn’t even realize I had already gone through 11 plates! The seared salmon nigiri was a standout for me. I’m definitely coming back until I’ve tried everything on their menu.
It is a great place for sushi! Very fresh and tasty. Survive is very fast and welcoming. The atmosphere is casual but very nice , it is not a fancy restaurant as it is a belt restaurant.

3226.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:45

3227.a: Kanabikino Falls, Takiba, Miyazu, Kyoto 626-0034, Japan
3227.aj: 〒626-0034 京都府宮津市滝馬 金引の滝

rv.t: One of Japan's 100 most beautiful waterfalls, and it's indeed really nice. There is a parking lot nearby, and the road has signs all the way there, so it's easy to get here by car.
I don't think the residents appreciate all the traffic.
宮津市の穴場スポットです。大きな滝ではないですが、大きな一枚岩を水が流れるような光景でちょっと珍しいのではないかと思います。不動尊の祠が近くにありお参りできます。

3228.a: Japan, 〒626-0001 Kyoto, Miyazu, Monju, 480-2 ちりめん問屋 貸 自転車 rental bicycle
3228.aj: 〒626-0001 京都府宮津市文珠４８０−２ ちりめん問屋 貸 自転車 rental bicycle
catj: 自転車レンタル サービス

rv.t: Recomended bike rental, 500¥ all day till 5pm.
Only Bike-Rental in the Area that let’s you rent the bikes for a whole day. Very nice staff!
600yan便可以租用單車一天，非常吸引。

3229.a: Japan, 〒627-0222 Kyoto, Kyotango, Tangocho Fudeshi, 青の洞窟
3229.aj: 〒627-0222 京都府京丹後市丹後町筆石青の洞窟

rv.t: 1日4名×4回なので、最大でも1日16名のツアーです。 申込時に宿泊先を聞かれたので、当日丹後地区に宿泊する人限定なのかもしれません。1時間くらいの行程で支払いはツアー終了時に船主さんへ現金で支払います。 1隻しか入れない狭い箇所の行き止まりについたところで、船主さんがココで振り返ってくださいと言われた先には驚異の絶景が広がっていました。 小さなボートなのでそこそこ揺れます。 帰り船酔いしてしまったので、乗り物酔いに弱い方は事前の対策をお勧めします。
竹野海水浴場からSUPで来てみました。 一般の方は船を予約して見に来られるようです。 入り口の岩の形が愛の女神だと言いますが少し無理やり感が(´・∀・｀) ただ海の透明度もあって美しいですね。

京都にこんな絶景があったとは。 四人乗りの小さな船で圧倒的な高さの玄武岩の岩山の麓の、ようやく船一台が通れる僅かな隙間のような洞窟に入り、後ろを振り返ると今まで見たこともない碧い光が広がります。 要予約で、天候次第で行けないことも多いみたいですが、丹後に来たなら、いやむしろ、青の洞窟を見るために丹後に行ってもいいくらいの、値打ちのある光景です。 現在、乗船料は６０００円/人 地元の民宿を利用しないと船を出してもらえないという口コミがありますが、デマです。宿泊なしで船を予約して、普通に乗せてもらえました。 波の影響で出港できない日が１／３程度あると。 なお、青の洞窟の青さは、晴天の青空が反射しているのではないため、曇り空でも青さを堪能できます。

3230.a: Inugasaki Cape, Tangocho Konoshiro, Kyotango, Kyoto 627-0232, Japan
3230.aj: 〒627-0232 京都府京丹後市丹後町此代犬ヶ岬

rv.t: 犬好きとしては気になる名前で訪れたいと思い訪ねました。 専用駐車場(トイレ有&防犯カメラ有)があるのでそこに停め、トンネルの横の遊歩道を歩いて行きます。 殆ど釣り人専用の駐車場のようで岬のてっぺんが目当てなのは私だけのようです。 岬までアップダウンの無い緩い下り坂の未舗装道で運動靴ぐらいで良いので履いた方が楽です。15分ぐらい歩くと到着しますが岬付近は落石の痕が生々しいので上に気をつけながら歩きました。 途中にお地蔵様が祀ってあります。 目的地は遊歩道の終点で屋根の無い東屋があり上を見上げると物凄い絶壁です。磯にはチラホラ釣り人がいますが凄い場所で釣りをしています。 犬が寝そべった姿に見えることから名付けられたらしいですが、どこから見たらそう言うふうに見えるのか判りませんでした。…
約1kmの遊歩道でしたが危険がいっぱい＾＾； 気を付けて歩いてください。力強くて雄大な 日本海を観ることが出来ます。屋根の無い展望台でゆっくり時間を過ごしては如何でしょうか？ 釣りをされている方も居ましたが危険を感じました。
2023/06/10 「丹後松島」から息を切らせて往復30分ほど。行く価値はない。 地元民と思われる釣り人はバイクで乗り入れてます。

3231.a: Nii Rice Terraces, Nii, Ine, Yoza District, Kyoto 626-0421, Japan
3231.aj: 〒626-0421 京都府与謝郡伊根町新井新井の千枚田

rv.t: Came here to see the Nii rice terraces but the steep ones along the upper mountain don't seem to be in use this year (2021). It's still a lovely area, and if you want to see the rice fields in Nii, you can head down the hill to the "main" road where there are still some larger ones right along the Japanese Sea. For that quintessential terraced rice field (with the tiers and unique shapes), I recommend traveling…
もう棚田としての役割は終え棚田の面影が少しばかり残っていました。 千枚田の水田としての美しさは見る事が出来ませんが、絶景スポットである事には変わりありません！ むしろ人がいなく静寂の中に時折聞こえる波の音と鳥の声は贅沢でした。 人の作った物が自然に還っていく過程の風景も何とも言えない情景。 ただ重機は使っていないのであれば無い方が良いと思います。
旧新井の棚田。今では休耕地となっています。 雑草が伸びて耕作地と畔との境も分かりづらくなっています。 昔は畔の曲線がハッキリ見えて、綺麗だったのだろうと想像しかできませでした。 眺めはいい場所です。

3232.a: Japan, 〒626-0202 Kyoto, Miyazu, Oshima, 大島の舟屋
3232.aj: 〒626-0202 京都府宮津市大島大島の舟屋

rv.t: Please come here only with a a guided tour. The bus from amanohashidate to ine was the worst 1 hour of my life. Better to come here on a comfortable bus
16時過ぎに訪問。 2階の舟屋はcloseでした。 1階のヒクサ。鯖、イカのバジル味いただきました。
こちらから観る景色もきれいですね。外海になるので天候で左右されると思います。

3233.a: Tango Umi to Hoshi no Mieru Oka Park, Satohami, Miyazu, Kyoto 626-0211, Japan
3233.aj: 〒626-0211 京都府宮津市里波見京都府立 丹後海と星の見える丘公園

rv.t: We drove out of our way to see the stars here at around 8pm because of the name. However when we arrived, we were informed it was closed and we had to leave. We were then followed and questioned when we stopped to check our return route on the way down the mountain. However we did get help on how to get back. Why call it 海と星見える公園 if you can't enter at night?
宿泊はしてませんが、1泊4000円とか？ トレーニングがてら、熊よけラジオを鳴らしながら散策に来てみると、眺望は天の橋立に引けを取らない眺め。 次回は別のコースもトレッキングしてみたい公園。
人は少ないですが、お弁当を食べるには最高の場所です。小さな池があり、生き物の観察もできます。子連れにおすすめです。

3234.a: Ine Fishing Village, Hirata, Ine, Yoza District, Kyoto 626-0423, Japan
3234.aj: 〒626-0423 京都府与謝郡伊根町平田伊根の舟屋
3234.ed: Small fishing village offering scenic water views, local shops & restaurants in a peaceful setting.
3234.edj: 風光明媚な海の景色を望む閑静な土地にある小さな漁村。地元の店舗や飲食店が並ぶ。

rv.t: If you’re exploring the Kansai region, Ine in Kyoto Prefecture is a fantastic day trip, and you can actually reach it through organized day tours from both Kyoto and Osaka. This small fishing village feels like stepping back in time. Life here has been shaped by the sea for centuries, and you can still see it in the traditional funaya boathouses—wooden homes built directly over the water where boats are stored…

You know when you visit some old Japanese towns and there are 30% of original buildings and the rest are the usual 60s eyesores? In this case the whole village is either old style houses and warehouses or they’ve been renovated to the precise original design and modernized. Astonishing. If you want the Amanohashidate strip you can take a bus here in only 30 mins. Come when it’s sunny.

Fun experience with a tiny bit of adventure! 🦅 Taking the boat ride here was fantastic, especially feeding the seagulls. But a quick word of advice: be really careful when you hold out the food! The local eagles join in too, and they aren't quite as precise as the seagulls—they can't easily tell the difference between the bird food and your fingers! Aside from the sudden aerial acrobatics, it was an absolute blast…

3235.a: Amanohashidate Shrine, 643-1 Monju, Miyazu, Kyoto 626-0001, Japan
3235.aj: 〒626-0001 京都府宮津市文珠６４３−１ 天橋立神社
3235.ed: Dedicated to the dragon gods, this place of worship is know for its pavilion & freshwater fountain.
3235.edj: 八大龍王を祀る神社。本殿と真水が湧く井戸が有名。

rv.t: A normal Japanese style temple.
A very serene shrine in the middle of the sandbank. Pine tree surrounds you with breeze. It is a nice place to worship and wander.

Shrine to the dragon gods. Amanohashidate Shrine is quite small, as many reviewers have pointed out. Nearby there is a pavilion which provides a nice place to rest in the shade if visiting during summer (which I was). The real appeal of this shrine is the purifying font to the left of the shine (closer to the water). While the bays on either side of the shrine are salt water, the font is "miraculously" fresh water…

3236.a: Ama Terrace, 1-1 Nakano, Miyazu, Kyoto 629-2232, Japan
3236.aj: 〒629-2232 京都府宮津市中野１−１ 傘松テラス
3236.ed: Visitors say this tourist destination offers breathtaking views of Amanohashidate, especially the "Shoryukan" view resembling a rising dragon, and is the origin of the "matanozoki" upside-down viewing experience. They also highlight the convenience of cable car and lift access, with some recommending the lift for the descent. Others appreciate the well-stocked souvenir shops and food options…
3236.edj: この観光地を訪れた人は、天橋立の息をのむような景色、特に昇り龍のように見える「昇龍観」を高く評価しています。また、「股のぞき」発祥の地であることでも知られています。ケーブルカーやリフトでアクセスしやすい点も好評で、下りにはリフトの利用を勧める声もあります。展望台には品揃えの豊富な土産物店や飲食店があることも、訪れた人から喜ばれています。

rv.t: Beautiful lookout with a gift shop selling local souvenirs. I would highly recommend the canned sardines from Amanohashidate as they are really good. Driving here? There's 3+ parking lots along the street up to the gondola station. There are attendants which will guide you to the lot to park in better than searching around for other lots.

Breathtaking scenery well worth visiting. We got there on a Saturday late morning and there’s a short line (about 8 minutes wait) going up; coming down at about 12.30pm, the wait was about 10-15 minutes.
A very good place to visit!

3237.a: Amanohashidate Viewland, 437 Monju, Miyazu, Kyoto 626-0001, Japan
3237.aj: 〒626-0001 京都府宮津市文珠４３７ 天橋立ビューランド
3237.ed: Monorail & chairlift access to a seaside summit with classic theme park rides & views of a sandbar.
3237.edj: 乗り物や砂州の景色を楽しめる遊園地。海辺の高台にあり、モノレールやリフトでアクセスする。

rv.t: Visiting Amanohashidate Viewland 天橋立ビューランド was a very good and enjoyable experience. The viewpoint offers a wonderful panorama of the famous sandbar, surrounded by mountains and the ocean on both sides. The scenery is beautiful and gives a clear idea of why Amanohashidate is known as one of Japan’s famous views. Walking around the area at the top is pleasant, with different spots where you can stop, take photos, and…

Amanohashidate View Land is a fantastic offbeat destination from Kyoto and absolutely worth a visit. The chair ropeway ride is a great experience in itself, offering beautiful scenic views on the way up. The entire journey, especially if you’re self-driving, is incredibly scenic and adds to the charm of the trip. The viewpoint at the top is stunning and perfect for relaxing and soaking in nature. A perfect spot for…

What a fab idea to combine an amusement park with a grand scenic lookout - great for families with kids and even for couples and adult groups alike! Really fun rides that give a higher vantage viewpoint - cycle ride and the Ferris wheel. But there are also other rides, like go-kart, carousel, shooting gallery, archery. Tickets are ¥400 per person per ride, regardless of the ride type, and can be purchased at the…

3238.a: Chionji Temple, 466 Monju, Miyazu, Kyoto 626-0001, Japan
3238.aj: 〒626-0001 京都府宮津市文珠４６６ 智恩寺
3238.ed: Known for its monthly flea market, this temple complex features a massive wooden gateway & shrine.
3238.edj: 毎月開催される蚤の市で知られる寺院。巨大な山門と社殿が特徴。

rv.t: A popular temple and place of interest in Amanohashidate. Free entry worship ground. Well maintained. Tranquil and sacred. The Ema was very special.

This a very quiet but extensive Zen Buddhist foundation. As such there is a distinct lack of ferocious guardian deities and other such highly colored statuary. The monastery is known for its academic achievements and there are small votive shrines throughout the temple precinct
Small but beautiful temple grounds with wooden pagoda and gate.

3239.aj: 〒626-0001 京都府宮津市文珠天橋立
3239.ed: This 3.6km sandbar is known for its picturesque views, beaches & thousands of pine trees.
3239.edj: 長さ 3.6 km の砂洲。美しい景観、砂浜、数千本もの松林で有名。

rv.t: A visit to Amanohashidate was definitely worth it. It’s easy to see why it’s considered one of Japan’s Three Scenic Views. We took the cable car up and enjoyed the stunning panoramic view of the dragon-shaped sandbar from the top. Although the weather was extremely hot in mid-July, the scenery was absolutely beautiful. After taking the cable car back down, we also enjoyed a relaxing walk along the beach. A place I’d…

Amanohashidate is one of the best easy day trips from Kyoto or Osaka, and you can reach it by train or guided tours. It’s a beautiful sandbar in northern Kyoto Prefecture, covered with pine trees and stretching across a calm bay. It’s famous as one of Japan’s “Three Scenic Views,” and the shape really looks like a natural bridge over the sea. The best way to enjoy it is to go up to the viewpoint by cable car or…

Visited Amanohashidate during May and the weather was very pleasant! From Osaka I got into a Hankyu Express Bus that departs from Osaka Umeda station and, among other spots, stops at Amanohashidate Station (I recommend the bus very much). We then checked the top view from Amanohashidate Viewland, which was great as well. Lines might seem a little too big, but they move quickly. Afterwards we walked a little along…
